notes: Startnummer recovered from the exact Sportstiming list header Startnr. where needed.
For individual 2022 results, explicit Kategori values such as F40-44/M45-49 may provide sex and age_category; exact age is never inferred from an interval.
2018, 2019 and 2023 remain without sex/age where the frozen public source does not expose those fields.

duo60.member_policy: Published member rows are retained with source_sequence. leg_no remains null until source evidence validates leg ordering.

verified_timing_schema.shorter_families: No intermediate split table was found in the complete imported public result details; finish/result analysis remains available without synthetic splits.

engine_readiness.rule: Map availability requires a local usable route asset. Replay additionally requires observed split checkpoints and a route version explicitly ready for replay anchoring.

deferred_until_next_phase_or_new_evidenc.reason: Wait for the Gotaleden generic refactor to be complete so ÖST does not fork an obsolete core.

Verified local route references now exist for Ultra 2018-2026 and Trail 21/22 2019 plus 2022-2026. Remaining gaps are Trail 21/22 2018 and historical Trail 13/14 and Trail 5 years without year-specific verified geometry.

Trail 14 has a materialized but explicitly provisional 13.472 km Hallamölla-splice reference and Trail 5 has a validated 2026 reconstruction. Authentic GPX/year-specific historical geometry is still needed before authoritative historical grouping.
Candidate public geometry is strongly compatible with 2019 but its Trace metadata is dated 2016, so year-specific provenance remains unresolved.
Member rows are imported, but available timing evidence does not validate that source row order always equals leg 1/2. Preserve source_sequence instead.
Repeat-runner analysis requires a separately documented linkage/confidence layer and must never overwrite source-local identity.
The frozen public source does not expose reliable sex/age fields for individual results in 2018, 2019 and 2023. Do not infer them from names.
The 2022/2023 service-window hypothesis remains operationally plausible but not physically verified.

do_not_redo: Do not refetch or rediscover Sportstiming 2018-2026 merely to start engine integration; the complete frozen archive and curated database already exist.
Use data/derived/ost-analysis-2018-2026.sqlite.gz as the primary source-side engine handoff and keep the frozen archive as provenance/source truth.
Do not infer course identity from marketing distance labels.
Do not collapse the 2022/2023 32 km and Bengtemölla observations into a single raw timing row.
Do not label the 32 km to Bengtemölla gap as confirmed aid-station dwell time unless physical timing-mat placement is independently verified.
Do not assign Duo leg numbers from member row order without stronger source evidence.
Do not infer cross-year person identity from names alone.
Do not copy the pre-refactor Gotaleden frontend wholesale into this repository.
